The climate in Stockholm

Stockholm is about 24 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 22°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 620 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in August (about 71 mm). The highest temperature in Stockholm in 2015–2024 was 32°C (21 July 2022) and the lowest −19°C (5 January 2017).

Best time to visit Stockholm

The most pleasant weather in Stockholm is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 21°C and 22°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month. In January and February nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
